notes: Generated from one source together with DESIGN.md. Agents may not edit this file.

forbidden_added_patterns.reason: code under src (unit tests included) uses expect("reason") instead of unwrap()

forbidden_removed_patterns.reason: INV-11 removing or rewriting an assertion

invariants.text: Default-path neutrality: `SwitchingConfig::evidence_driven`, `SwitchingConfig::default()` and the direct Rodas5p/Dopri5 solves keep bit-identical states and identical counters on the registered cells, unless the task kind is default_behaviour. Evidence: `skeleton_helpers_reproduce_registered_counters` stays green.

research/LEDGER.jsonl is append-only: one JSON object per line with the ten fields of docs/RESEARCH_LEDGER.md. Existing rows use mixed key orders and separators; new rows are written by the row script of DESIGN.md 13.2.

Units: a guard ceiling is in callback units (RHS 1, JVP 1 per vector, dense Jacobian n). WorkModel V2 values are instruction units (Ir). Convert V2 to a callback ceiling only through `v2_entry_callback_cap` / `v2_return_callback_cap`.
Decision preservation: an early stop armed by a ceiling never changes a strict entry/return decision compared with the same comparison run without the ceiling.
Determinism: no wall clock, randomness, thread timing or HashMap iteration order in any decision path; epoch digests use the FNV-1a hasher after F7.
Accounting completeness: every user-callback evaluation made by the library is added to `stats.rhs_calls` / `stats.jvp_vectors` (or the matching counter).
Scope: only files listed in the task's files_allowed (plus always_allowed) change.
Public API is additive: no public item is removed, renamed or changes signature unless the task says so.
Opt-in: new behaviour is reachable only through the named factory or a config field whose default keeps the old behaviour (task kinds opt_in_behaviour, experiment).
Tests first: every behavioural test of the task fails on the task's base commit (`agent_gate.py red`) and passes after the change.
No weakening: existing assertions, tolerances and test functions are not deleted or relaxed, except the exact lines listed in the task's removals_allowed.
No new dependencies, toolchain or lockfile changes; no unsafe code; no lint suppression attributes.

Research claims: a verdict comes only from the preregistered gate; PREREGISTRATION.md is never edited above its results section; a ledger row whose commit is not reachable from a remote is not written.
Exactness: anchors are matched as exact text with the stated occurrence count; never edit by line number or by approximate match.
Traceability: every finished task has one commit with the task's commit_message, a PROGRESS.md entry and a passing gate record in .agent/STATE.json.
